blocks.text: 1. SSSR-nin şimalinde Şimalij Buzlu deniz (Şimalij Buzlь deniz) Bardыr. Buzlu deniz júlη jarüsündan zijadesinde Buzlar ile ertyli olur. Ja- ьz qarвda Murman jalыlarь Golfstrom sajesinde Buzlamaz. Buralarda qüşün ajlarça kyneş kerinmez. Bejleçe Murmanda eki aj; Novaja zemla adalarda dert aj qadar geçe devam eter. Jazda ise, ajlar kecer, kyneş hic Batmaz; ufuq ystinde ajlanьr turar. Jazda Bile kyneş pеk az qьzdüгда- mondan hava epiçe salqún, jaqчmürlü olur. Hatta, kimerde qar da javar.

translations.en: 1. In the north of the USSR there is the Arctic Sea. The frozen sea is covered with ice in its rise from the heat of July. In the winter snow, the Murman beaches will not freeze thanks to the Gulf Stream. It's easy to get tired here. Two pilgrims in Bejleçe Murman; Novaja will last about four nights on the islands. In jazz, however, ajlar kejer, kynesh hij Batmaz; it is hovering over the horizon. Even in spring, when the sun is very low, the air is very cool and warm. Sometimes it even snows.

blocks.text: Buzlu deniznin jalыlarьnda jaşaqan insanlar pеk azdür. Onlar ваlьq ve Başqa deniz hajvanlarьünü avlamaq ile meşqyl olurlar.

translations.en: Very few people live on the shores of the frozen sea. They are busy hunting for whales and other sea animals.

blocks.text: Aşaqdaki meqaleni oqumağa başlamadan egine Şimalij Buzlь deniz jalыlaгь haqqыnda evvelden egrengen şejlerinizni Bir daha tekrarla ve No- vaja zemla adalarының дасьпҫь arz dereçesinde olganlarins hisaslan.

translations.en: Before you start reading the following article, repeat what you have already learned about the North Sea ice and feel that the Novaja land islands are in the supply chain.

blocks.text: Şimal Buzlь denizinde, tar Bоqaz ile Bir-Birinden ajrыlgan eki вуjуk ada вагdüг, ki вunlarnьη her ekisine Birden „Janь jer" derler.

translations.en: In the Northern Ice Sea, the tar Boqaz and the Bir-Birinden ajrыlgan eki вуjуk ada вагdüг, ki вunlarnьη her ekisine Birden „Janь jer" derler.

blocks.text: Janú jernin tabiatь son dereçе fuqaredir. Şimaldeki Byjуk ada Buz sahralarьnь апdыгьг. Çеnувdеki ada, jazda qardan temizlenir ise de, munda da jene (Şimal qьsmьnda) hic irimegen hareketsiz Buz cellerine, Buz qajalarьna rast kelinir.

translations.en: The nature of Janu Jer is extremely poor. The island of Byjuk in the north is located in the Ice Desert. Although the island in Chenuv is cleared of snow in the summer, here again (in the northern part) there are motionless ice cells and ice rocks.
